items.summary: Ensure the Google Search Console HTML verification file is publicly accessible at the exact site-root path `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html` and returns HTTP 200 with the file body containing `google-site-verification: googlea74065339385fd9b.html`.

Make the verification file resilient to a trailing-slash request by serving equivalent verification content for `https://vsapplianceshub.in/googlea74065339385fd9b.html/` (as shown in the user’s Google Search Console flow), without breaking the non-trailing-slash URL.
